firstPlayerRule: The player who last ate a cookie starts the game by choosing a character token and placing it in front of a row or column.
clarifications: The other player places their token perpendicular to the first player's choice and activates the first tile. The cookie eater makes the first placement but the other player takes the first tile action.
The same opening rule is used with both the classic and quick setup.
internalEvidence: Lubee Edition's product page https://shop.lubee-edition.com/products/cookie-addict confirms the title and publisher for BGG identity 306032. The publisher-hosted English manual's PDF pages 2–3 were rendered and visually checked. Page 2 names the cookie eater as player 1; page 3 explicitly gives player 2 the first tile activation.
